rule: Written after the diagnostic trials on development material (results-tone-forecaster-04/diagnosis) and before the formal development run. Candidates, all driven by the v2 gate's decision: the joint band check of study 02 with the gate faded instead of switched (a cosine fade over 8 blocks in and 8 out, joint_fade8; 8 in and 3 out, joint_fade8in3out; one block is 10 ms), and the band check that judges each setting after its own copy of the gate (tone_gate_fade.GatedCheckBank) with the hard gate (gcheck), the 8/8 fade (gcheck_fade8) and the 8/3 fade (gcheck_fade8in3out). Development material: the eight study-01 development recordings, the 44 development synthetic scenes and study 03's 8 buzz scenes. A boost is a third-octave band 1 dB or more louder; a near-boost 0.5 dB or more; both are counted over development recordings (either horizon) plus late synthetic windows. Eligible only if: (a) fewer boosts than joint + gate; (b) the gate's boosts are gone: on the buzz scenes, no more late boosts than the joint check with no gate at all; (c) no more near-boosts than joint + gate; (d) no more whole-band boosts (whole 35-350 Hz band below -0.5 dB on a development recording) than joint + gate; (e) the tone gain over v2 is kept: the median, over development acoustic recordings with reference tones, of the tone-bin gain averaged over both horizons is at least v2 + gate's plus half of the amount by which joint + gate exceeds v2 + gate; (f) the median whole-band gain over development acoustic recordings, averaged over both horizons, is at least joint + gate's minus 0.1 dB; (g) the mean synthetic objective is at least joint + gate's minus 0.5 dB and its synthetic windows below -0.5 dB are no more than joint + gate has; (h) the compute it adds is small: over all development runs, the median of its own 99th-percentile time per 10 ms block (fade included) minus joint + gate's in the same run is at most 1 ms. Among eligible candidates, pick the one with the fewest boosts, then the fewest near-boosts, then the higher tone-bin median. If none is eligible, nothing is frozen: the joint check and v2 are unchanged, and there is nothing to test on fresh recordings.
